gates.name: reference-agreement:levene_vs_scipy_car
gates.detail: 10/10 agree [f_statistic=3.4157 vs ref 3.4157; neg_log10_p=2.0648 vs ref 2.0648; df1=4 vs ref 4; df2=1839 vs ref 1839; max_diff_scipy=3.5527e-15 vs ref 0; max_diff_car=5.7288e-14 vs ref 0; bartlett_p=0.079072 vs ref 0.079072; variances_differ=1 vs ref 1; bartlett_disagrees=1 vs ref 1; n=1844 vs ref 1844]
gates.citation: Levene H (1960); Brown & Forsythe (1974). Reference impls: scipy.stats.levene(center='median') and car::leveneTest(center=median); Bartlett (1937) via base R bartlett.test. Data: vertical-GRF dynamic range across five gait classes, GaitRec (Horsak et al. 2020).

reference.citation: Levene H (1960); Brown & Forsythe (1974). Reference impls: scipy.stats.levene(center='median') and car::leveneTest(center=median); Bartlett (1937) via base R bartlett.test. Data: vertical-GRF dynamic range across five gait classes, GaitRec (Horsak et al. 2020).
reference.description: re-computes Levene's (Brown-Forsythe) test of the vertical-GRF dynamic-range variance across the five gait classes with scipy.stats.levene(center='median') and car::leveneTest(center=median) and confirms leveneTest reproduces both to machine precision; also reports the classical Bartlett p, showing the robust/classical disagreement
